purpose: Prospectively screen a public 35/70 MPa hydrogen-dispenser vehicle-refueling experiment for synchronized station/dispenser/vehicle boundary channels before any numerical outcome is used.

source.title: Study on comprehensive evaluation of 35 MPa/70 MPa hydrogen dispenser refueling performance
source.public_access_path: Article page exposes downloadable CSV ZIP supplementary tables.

known_before_freeze: The article reports 35 MPa logistics-vehicle and 70 MPa passenger-vehicle refueling tests.
The article describes pressure, temperature and mass-flow recording for the 70 MPa test.
The article describes vehicle tank volume, pressure, temperature, transferred mass and elapsed time summaries.
The article page exposes four downloadable CSV ZIP links labelled T1 through T4.

exclusion_rules: Do not infer a channel role from a plotted curve when the CSV lacks a publisher crosswalk.
Do not convert a summary table into a time series.
Do not score a case unless all required channels share a declared time base or the publisher explicitly crosswalks them.
Do not fit geometry, thresholds or model parameters to the candidate outcome.
Retain an ineligible result as a negative intake result rather than substituting another case.

claim_boundary: This protocol is an outcome-free intake and scoring plan. It does not claim that the article's CSV files are full-loop, machine-readable, licensed for redistribution, or sufficient for validation until the exact archives, headers, units, time base, geometry and rights are inspected. A passing single case cannot by itself close the repository full-loop gate requiring an independent cohort.
